in_marathi.name: Geeshna
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Geeshna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Geeshna is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'geet', which means 'song' or 'knowledge'. In Hindu mythology, Geeshna is the goddess of knowledge and learning. She is often depicted with a book in her hand or as a beautiful woman surrounded by scholars. Geeshna is believed to bestow wisdom and knowledge upon those who seek her blessings.
